title: worker-branch main-merges resolve .beads to deletion; branch tree diverges from main store snapshots
description: Edge-cases review finding on jg6w (merge 5c875d7693 + restoration 87f166a5e4 on beads-worker-5). Mechanism: the pre-commit hook (policy bead biod: 'beads store is main-only') forces .beads deltas out of worker-branch commits, so when merging main the .beads paths must be unstaged; doing so via 'git restore --staged .beads' reverted conflicted/added entries to the worker side: (1) .beads/counter.json took the worker subset — lossless vs the disk mirror and no bd-op impact (BEADS_DIR at lichen-workspace is authoritative) and no counter regression on merge-into-main (branch carries no counter delta), but (2) 9 issue + 9 events files that main tracks (e.g. project-LICHEN-worker6-mjm7.json, closed live state) are absent from the merge tree while the disk holds them main-equal untracked — every future main merge re-fights the same modify/delete conflicts (active desync between committed tree and disk mirror). Remedy options needing Mark's policy call: (a) hook exempts .beads for merge commits whose other parent is main (let main's store tree win), (b) sync script pre-merge step: reset .beads paths to main + stash untracked (pattern already used ad hoc, see worker stashes), (c) document the stash workaround as the standard. Evidence: 5c875d7693, 87f166a5e4, debris commit 17e39dbb31, hook message text.
